transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Thanks. Well, I came in today because... the thought of getting on an airplane just scares me so bad right now. I mean, I know in my head it doesn't make any sense, I really do, but... my whole body just tells me that the plane is going to fall. It's just really bad, and I don't know what to do about it.
Do you experience this kind of intense fear or panic in any other situations, or is it only related to flying?

No, it's really just flying. I mean, I can ride in elevators, I can drive on the highway, I don't have any problems with heights or anything like that. It's... it's strictly airplanes. When I'm not thinking about flying, I'm completely fine.
How long have you been dealing with this intense fear of flying?

It's been going on for about seven months now. Um, it started right after I lost my clinic job. I had to take a flight on this small plane, and it was just... incredibly turbulent. Really rough. And ever since that specific flight, I've just been terrified of getting back on one.
